- **Drill state** (vs bare king): two rooks — the king is on the edge (rank 8). FINISH: one major holds rank 7 (the rank just inside) as the wall; the OTHER major checks along rank 8 from far away — that check is MATE. Keep your own king off rank 8 so it doesn't block the check. Verify `gives checkmate` with imagine_move (a quiet move to 0 squares would be stalemate).
  Right now: enemy king on rank 8 (the edge); wall on rank 7: h7; major(s) free to check rank 8: a6. Work out the checking move and confirm `gives checkmate` with imagine_move.
  CHECK FROM A DISTANCE: a check that lands on a square next to the king (same rank, adjacent file) is just captured (e.g. a rook to a8 with the king on b8). Deliver the edge check from a file at least TWO away from the king's file. If no safe mating check is available yet, make a WAITING move — slide the WALL rook (the one on rank 7) sideways to the far end of its rank, away from the king; the king is in zugzwang and must step toward the corner, then your check is mate. Test both with imagine_move.
  AVOID dead checks: a check landing on a8 loses the rook (the king captures it there); NO safe check exists yet — make a WAITING move (slide the wall rook sideways, far from the king) so the king must step, then check.
